title: Close the rv331-ward188c residuals: an inode-only inert arm and four INFOs in the cut path and in doctor
description:
Filed from WCLI-82 by the ward-cli worker on 2026-10-26, out of the rv331-ward188c confirmation pass recorded verbatim on WCLI-82 (opum-ai/ward-cli#188, APPROVE at baf3a7a). The verdict called these one LOW and four INFOs and none of them blocks 0.1.0. They are filed as ONE task because they share a cause and a moment: each is a place the next release's cut, or doctor's report, would be wrong once a second tag exists, a worktree is deleted and re-created, or a surviving directory has no .git above it. All five sit in the code and docs the 0.1.0 cut leaves behind.

1. LOW, the only real gap. test/reporting.test.ts's inert-arm table has no arm that varies inode alone. Deleting probed.inode !== record.inode at reporting.ts:417 turns nothing red, because the device arm still fires on device. Inode alone is the realistic case: a worktree deleted and re-created at the same path on the same volume. Without that clause doctor would call the record clearable and exit 6 on a step that cannot replace it, which is the Q2 dead end DEC-246 (a3) closed. The fix the verdict would accept is an inode-mismatch arm shaped like the device arm, setting record.inode to its current value plus one.

2. INFO. The cutting runbook's dry-run poll loop (:89-95) has no bound. If no matching run ever appears the loop spins forever, and the verdict is not certain that gh's --jq prints an empty line rather than the text null for a null result. The fix it proposes is to select the id with a null coalescing to empty and to bound the number of attempts, failing with a named error rather than looping.

3. INFO. The no-manifest inert case in reporting.test.ts asserts status only. Doctor's stale_approvals entry for that arm, which the verdict reports as pass with code other_projects, an empty list and a count of 1, is not pinned there, so a regression in doctor's half of that arm would go unnoticed.

4. INFO. release.yml:120 sorts with -v:refname, which puts vX-rc.N above vX when both are reachable, so a later release would read its "before" snapshot from the release candidate rather than the last final release. The verdict's fix is to sort with versionsort.suffix=- set to the empty string. It is irrelevant to 0.1.0, where the reachable list is empty, and the worker's multi-line path through that expression is unmeasured because its state 3 had only one reachable tag.

5. INFO. When no .git is found anywhere above a surviving directory, checkout.ts's probe throws and the throw is reported as "that directory no longer exists". The record stays inert, which is right, and only the wording is wrong.

Authority note: items 1 to 4 complete behaviour already recorded and decided. Item 5 changes a user-facing sentence, so if opum-doc wants different wording than a corrected one, that decision governs and this task records it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Deleting the inode comparison at reporting.ts:417 turns a test red, and the inert-arm table has one arm per compared field: root, device and inode.
The cutting runbook's dry-run poll exits with a named error after a bounded number of attempts instead of spinning forever, and a null run id is never passed to gh run watch.
The no-manifest inert case pins doctor as well as status: doctor reports stale_approvals as pass with code other_projects, an empty record list and a count of 1.
The previous-tag lookup sorts a release candidate below its final release, measured with two reachable tags, vX-rc.N and vX.
A surviving directory with no .git anywhere above it is reported as something other than that directory no longer exists, and the record stays inert.
